metrics.metric: Performance Policy threshold: EPS of at least $3.00 or RORCE of at least the median of the Financial Performance Peer Group
metrics.evidence: EPS of at least $3.00 or (2) RORCE of at least the median of the Financial Performance Peer Group

metrics.metric: Individual Performance (qualitative objectives including risk management, compliance and diversity and inclusion)
metrics.evidence: These objectives include compliance with our policies on information security, regulatory compliance, risk management accountability and diversity and inclusion objectives
progress on diversity and inclusion initiatives
reinforcing a strong risk culture and continuing to strengthen risk management practices in our businesses

metrics.metric: Company Financial Performance (net income, EPS, RORCE, ROE, total stockholder return, capital return)
metrics.evidence: the Company's 2015 net income of $22.9 billion, diluted EPS of $4.12, and RORCE of 12.8%

metrics.metric: Strategic Priorities (customer relationships, revenue growth, risk management, expense management, community engagement, diversity and inclusion)
metrics.evidence: the Company's progress on key strategic priorities, including building and maintaining enduring relationships with our customers

metrics.metric: Connecting with communities (United Way workplace giving, corporate cash donations)
metrics.evidence: connecting with communities, as reflected by ranked by United Way Worldwide as largest workplace-giving campaign

metrics.metric: Customer relationships (deep and enduring relationships with customers)
metrics.evidence: success in furthering the Company's objectives of creating deep and enduring relationships with our customers

metrics.metric: Business line financial results and strategic business line objectives
metrics.evidence: the HRC considered business line financial results not in isolation or with a predetermined or set importance or weight

metrics.metric: Relative RORCE ranking versus Financial Performance Peer Group, subject to absolute RORCE performance levels
metrics.evidence: 2015 Performance Share awards are scheduled to vest in the first quarter of 2018 based on the average of the Company's RORCE over the three-year performance period

metrics.metric: Net Operating Loss downward adjustment of target Performance Shares
metrics.evidence: for any year in the three-year performance period that the Company incurs a Net Operating Loss (NOL), the target number of Performance Shares will be reduced by one-third

metrics.metric: Performance-based vesting conditions (risk and conduct triggers for cancellation of Performance Shares)
metrics.evidence: The HRC has full discretion to cancel all or a portion of these Performance Share awards upon the occurrence of the specified performance-based vesting conditions

metrics.metric: Performance-based vesting conditions (cancellation of RSRs for CEO annual incentive)
metrics.evidence: subject to the HRC's full discretion to cancel all or a portion of this award upon the occurrence of specified performance-based vesting conditions
